title: Nice Boys
lyrics:
[00:32.09] Ain't it just so easy to say
[00:35.35] You don't feel the same way
[00:39.14] As that nice boy does, hey?
[00:44.21] He misses you, he wants you
[00:47.03] But, you just don't feel the same
[00:50.76] Why don't you tell him today?
[00:55.45] Yeah, huh-huh-huh
[00:57.45] She doesn't want him because he cares too much
[01:02.90] But now he's gone and she's alone again
[01:09.96] Maybe if she tried a little harder to find
[01:16.20] The gem within his heart that was there this whole time
[01:22.39] (Bitch!)
[01:24.84] 
[02:08.06] Baby, what did I do?
[02:12.98] Baby come through
[02:16.87] To me
[02:20.62] Baby I think it's you
[02:25.92] Never was me
[02:27.93]
